verdict.rationale: An API management platform like Kong/Konnect could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. However, the evidence never documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The AI Gateway, MCP traffic governance, the Konnect MCP server and AI CLI proxying are infrastructure for other agents, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
